subject: Transient assurance letter inquiry — LyraHealth SOC 2 period gap
messages:
From: Sara Goldstein <sara@lyrahealth.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Transient assurance letter request for post-report period

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking this. We just received Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report (period ended 2026-06-30) and our audit team has a small gap: our contract signing window runs through 2026-11-30. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a short transient assurance / "post-report" letter that:

- Affirms there were no significant control changes impacting the scope since 2026-06-30 through 2026-11-30, or
- If there were changes, lists them and any compensating controls in place.

Our procurement deadline is 2026-11-20, so a response by EOD 2026-11-12 would be ideal.

I've attached the SOC 2 we have on file and a one-page checklist of the evidence our audit team typically requests (requested_evidence_checklist.xlsx). If you can provide a draft wording we can accept, that will speed approval.

Thanks,
Sara Goldstein
Director, Security & Compliance
LyraHealth
Attachments: LyraHealth_SOC2-TypeII-2026-06.pdf, requested_evidence_checklist.xlsx
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Goldstein <sara@lyrahealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Transient assurance letter request for post-report period

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear asks and for attaching the checklist.

Short answer: yes, we can provide a transient assurance letter that addresses the post-report period through 2026-11-30. We typically do a short attestation that:

- Restates the SOC 2 report period (to avoid confusion),
- Notes that between the report date and requested cutoff there were no management-level changes to the control environment that would adversely affect the covered trust services, or
- When applicable, a brief description of any control changes and mitigations.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll coordinate with Rishi (security & infra) to confirm whether any scoped control changes occurred between 2026-06-30 and today.
- If changes exist, we'll prepare a concise description and highlight compensating controls or monitoring evidence.
- We'll provide a draft letter for your legal/audit team review by EOD 2026-11-12.

Rishi/Laura — can you confirm estimated turnaround for evidence checks and whether we need to redact any KMS key IDs before sharing? I anticipate 1 business day for the initial draft and another day for evidence packaging.

Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0198
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 12:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Transient assurance letter request for post-report period

Naomi — quick status:

- No architecture or management-level control changes in the SOC 2 scope since 2026-06-30 that would materially affect the trust services.
- Minor operational tweak: rotated one HSM cluster for keycard-protected maintenance (no production data exposure). We have the maintenance ticket and HSM rotation logs.

I attached a small snapshot of the KMS audit (kms-audit-snapshot.csv) and a pointer to the maintenance ticket for your write-up. We should redact full key IDs; provide high-level identifiers and dates only.

Proposed response packet for the letter:
- One-page attestation signed by Naomi referencing the 2026-06-30 SOC 2 report, the requested cutoff date (2026-11-30), and a statement of no material control changes OR a short note of the maintenance activity above.
- Supporting evidence: maintenance ticket ID, redacted KMS audit snapshot, and link to our change control log.

I can assemble the evidence package by EOD tomorrow (2026-11-11) and Naomi can review the attestation draft.

—Rishi
Director, Infra Security
Redwood Inference
Attachments: kms-audit-snapshot.csv
From: Maya Singh <contracts@lyrahealth.com>

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:47:00 -0500

Hi Naomi — thanks for the quick coordination. A couple of clarifications from procurement/legal:

- The letter should be on Redwood letterhead and include a named contact for follow-up (email + phone).
- Redaction is fine for any key identifiers — please include the maintenance ticket reference and a brief sentence confirming no data exposure.
- We need the signed PDF by EOD 2026-11-15 to meet our internal timing, but Sara will accept a draft earlier for audit review.

If you can share the draft today or tomorrow, we'll route it through our audit/legal. Also confirm whether DocuSign is required or if a signed PDF from Naomi suffices.

Thanks — Maya
Senior Contracts Manager
LyraHealth
